about: The names of the desktop-core IPC, by the rest of their constant name: Go has backend.Op*, Event*, State* and protocol.Stage*, Power*; desktop/ipc.h has ipc::Op* and so on. A console's state is one of states or stages. maxFrame is the largest video frame in pixels: Go has video/raster.MaxWidth and MaxHeight, desktop/ipc.h has ipc::MaxFrameWidth and MaxFrameHeight. A media event reports the ISO's state in mounted and, when the ISO failed, why in message. fields lists the JSON keys of each message part; the profile's keys are those of connect.json.
